text:
maya: Quick thread to lock alpha acceptance for the obs console (dashboards + traces + cost). We need concrete checks so pilots can sign off.
alan: Pilot orgs = Nimbus (prod) + Medly (staging). Nimbus needs per-route cost snapshots; Medly needs error-slice alerts.
frank: From infra: telemetry retention default 7d, topic retention 7d, will add per-tenant cap. We need a deployment flag and an emergency cutoff.
sophie: UX: we'll deliver a single "Overview" dashboard with three panels: latency percentiles, cost trend (sampled), and top error traces. Keep interactions minimal for alpha.
ben: Engineering constraints: add minimal span tags: model, route, tenant, token_count. Sampling: default 1% and force-capture on error. Header X-RW-SAMPLE to override for testing.
maya: Acceptance criteria proposal:
1) Overview dashboard visible to pilot orgs with sample data
2) Runtime emits span metadata and token_count for pilot traffic
3) Cost rollups exported as 7d CSV for admins
4) Error-slice alerts configurable and firing in pilot tests
5) Canary plan + rollback documented
6) Perf: tracing overhead <1.5% median for pilot workload
alan: I'll own runtime part and will add a tiny PR checklist: new spans must be <200 bytes, batched to telemetry producer, and gated by feature-flag.
frank: Ops will own canary: 2% traffic in region-us-east-1, monitor CPU, latency, telemetry lag. Rollback if any metric breaches threshold for 10m.
sophie: I'll ship a simple tooltip explaining sampling and cost estimates. Also will include a small in-product link to pilot docs.
ben: For cost estimator: server-side estimator with model.profile + token_count histogram. Accuracy target: within 10% on pilot data. We'll add nightly drift checks.
ci-bot: ci-bot: created branch obs/alpha-acceptance and checklist template.
maya: Ok locking these criteria. Owners file short RFCs by EOD Wed. Review sync Thu 9:30am. Add last asks now.
frank: Note: storage policy - full traces only stored when error=true or sampled_override. Keep total full-trace retention 14d for pilot.
maya: Thanks all. We'll proceed with alpha scope as above. :rocket:
